description: Write acceptance tests for the planner module in test/acceptance/planner.test.js from .hub/spec.md and the interface JSDoc only (do not read or rely on implementation details). Cover documented behavior, exact strings, error classes and codes, and edge cases. No network: inject fake fetch, sources and routers. Tests may fail until the module is built.
summary: 32 acceptance tests in test/acceptance/planner.test.js (commit 7d9ca69) covering validatePlanRequest (defaults, limits, extra fields, InputError/TripTooLongError codes) and planRoutes (first router call, corridor bbox, cameraIds order, avoid loop, maxAvoid cap, 4-call limit, unavoidable cameras, fewest-cameras/shorter-duration choice, area growth and refetch, exact notes and order, error propagation). Fake source and router, no network. All fail now with NotImplementedError. Checked against a scratch reference built from the JSDoc: 32/32 pass under every reading of the open points, and 12 planted bugs were each caught. Decisions planner-tests.1 and planner-tests.2 logged.
title: Acceptance tests for route planning
